chapters.reason: MMaDA is a multimodal diffusion foundation model that operates on continuous latent representations, fitting the embedding-based diffusion model category.
The paper emphasizes a mixed long chain-of-thought (CoT) fine-tuning strategy and unified post-training, which aligns with training strategies for complex reasoning.
The paper demonstrates multi-step reasoning and multimodal understanding capabilities, showcasing the application of its unified diffusion architecture.
